commands.description: Activates DPOJET application

migration.notes: Not needed on MSO 4/5/6. Jitter and eye measurements are built into the measurement system.

commands.description: Adds a measurement of the specified type

params.name: value
params.description: One of: PERIOD, FREQUENCY, PDUTY, NDUTY, PWIDTH, NWIDTH, CCPERIOD, PCCDUTY

migration.notes: Most types map directly. EYEHEIGHT→HEIGHT, EYEWIDTH→WIDTH, SETUPTIME→SETUP, HOLDTIME→HOLD, DCCOMMONMODE→COMMONMODE. MASKHITS moved to EYEMASK commands. OVERSHOOT split into POVERSHOOT/NOVERSHOOT.

value_map.MASKHITS: REMOVED: Use EYEMASK:MASK<x>:COUNt:HITS? for mask hit counting
value_map.HIGHLOWDIFF: REMOVED: Compute via MATH or use HIGH and LOW separately
value_map.CYCLEMAX: REMOVED: Use MAXIMUM with cycle mode
value_map.CYCLEMIN: REMOVED: Use MINIMUM with cycle mode
value_map.CYCLEPKPK: REMOVED: Use PK2Pk with cycle mode
value_map.PCCDUTY: NEEDS_VERIFICATION: May map to CCJITTER with duty config
value_map.NCCDUTY: NEEDS_VERIFICATION: May map to CCJITTER with duty config
value_map.SSCPROFILE: REMOVED: SSC profile display handled via plots
value_map.SSCFREQDEVMIN: NEEDS_VERIFICATION: May be queryable from results
value_map.SSCFREQDEVMAX: NEEDS_VERIFICATION: May be queryable from results
value_map.TCMDCMD: NEEDS_VERIFICATION: May not be available outside DDR-specific measurements
